title: フレッシュブリーズミスト

segments.caption: 日常に、さわやかな風を。

The woman picks up a sleek, minimalist mist bottle (the product). She smiles slightly, sprays the mist into the air, and takes a deep, refreshing breath. Her whole posture instantly becomes energized. <d>[Japanese] 日常に、さわやかな風を。</d>.
